description: This Mendeley Data release contains hourly solar-irradiance and photovoltaic-power measurements from the Zero Emission Building laboratory in Trondheim, Norway. The research team published six Excel workbooks, with separate radiation and PV-power collections for 2023, 2024 and 2025. Pyranometers cover north, east, west and south facades, a sixty-degree pergola and a thirty-degree south-facing roof. The article relates the signals to seasonal daylight, snow, clouds and building shading in a high-latitude setting. Current version 2 is public under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one monitored research building over three years; it does not establish production profiles for every facade design or a regional solar resource map. Sensor geometry and local obstruction need to be retained when comparing simulated irradiance or generation. A reviewer-assessed use is testing facade-PV yield or building-integrated solar assumptions. model-energyplus is a related building simulation tool, but no direct workbook importer or calibrated model is reported here. The Mendeley release and six filenames were inspected without downloading measurements.
